name: sterlingrx-advisors
description: Pharmacy business intelligence. One Node process serves the Express API and the React site.

scripts.//postinstall: Server only. The server serves client/dist, which is prebuilt and committed, so it needs no client packages to run -- and installing them would put vite, rollup and esbuild on a shared host that charges for disk and may not finish the install at all.
scripts.//build: Installs the client toolchain first, so a fresh clone can build without a separate step. Run on your own machine, not the host.
scripts.build: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.build:web: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build
